description: This Java source file defines the 'Contract' entity class, representing awarded contracts between contractors and projects within the system. It includes fields for contract details and getter/setter methods, mapped to a database table.

classes.name: Contract
classes.description: Entity class representing a contract awarded between a contractor and a project, mapped to the 'contracts' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the contract.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the contract.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a project entity with this contract.

methods.name: setContractor
methods.description: Associates a contractor entity with this contract.

methods.name: getContractNumber
methods.description: Returns the contract number as a string.

methods.name: getAwardDate
methods.description: Returns the date the contract was awarded.

methods.name: setAwardDate
methods.description: Sets the award date for the contract.

methods.name: getCompletionDate
methods.description: Returns the date the contract was completed.

methods.name: setCompletionDate
methods.description: Sets the completion date for the contract.

methods.name: getContractValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the contract.

methods.name: setContractValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the contract.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the contract (e.g., ACTIVE, COMPLETED).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the contract.
